title: The Ant's Grand Quest
summary: A determined ant discovers that teamwork and persistence can accomplish the impossible when it unites its colony to bring home an enormous treasure.

pages.text: A tiny ant lived in a small black hill.
pages.scene: A small ant standing at the entrance of an ant hill

pages.text: This ant was smart and loved to think.
pages.scene: Ant observing the world around with curiosity

pages.text: One cold fall day, she found a grand pink lump.
pages.scene: Ant discovering a huge piece of candy in the grass

pages.text: "We must bring this food back fast!" she said.
pages.scene: Ant realizing this treasure could feed the entire colony

pages.text: But it was too big and too hard.
pages.scene: Ant struggling alone with the huge candy, unable to move it

pages.text: The ant went back and sang a call.
pages.scene: Ant returning home and using special signals to gather helpers

pages.text: Ten ants came to help and to push.
pages.scene: Multiple ants arriving and working together on the treasure

pages.text: They bent and they bumped, pushed and pulled with all their strength.
pages.scene: Ants straining together to move the candy forward

pages.text: At last, the pink lump went into the hill!
The ant had found that together, ants can do everything.
pages.scene: Colony celebrating the successful mission together
Ant as hero, surrounded by grateful colony members
